api_url.description: Kubernetes API server URL (typically the internal cluster endpoint).

kubeconfig.description: Absolute path to a kubeconfig file with credentials for accessing the cluster.

token_file.description: Absolute path to a file containing a bearer token (used if kubeconfig unavailable).

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace scope for VM operations. Leave empty to allow cross-namespace operations.

verify_ssl.description: Enable (true) or disable (false) TLS certificate validation when connecting to the API server.

ca_cert.description: Optional absolute path to a custom CA certificate bundle (PEM format).

retry.description: Number of times to retry failed API requests before marking an operation as failed.

timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for a single API operation to complete.

extra_headers.description: List of additional HTTP headers to send with every API request.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level for the fence agent.

log_file.description: Path to write logs (empty or 'stdout' for console output).
